text:
You need a reliable way to track employee productivity, capture daily work logs, and turn that data into clear Excel-based reporting and dashboards.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, SQL, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, and data visualization. I can help you build an Employee Productivity Tracker that is structured, accurate, and easy to use for ongoing monitoring.

My approach would be to first organize the tracker around the core data you need: employee details, daily work logs, and performance metrics. From there, I would clean and standardize the data so it stays consistent and usable. I’d then build the analysis layer in Excel to track productivity patterns, compare performance over time, and highlight key trends. If needed, I can also help structure external benchmark data so it fits cleanly into the reporting workflow.

For visual reporting, I can create dashboards that summarize the most important insights in a clear format for management review. I focus on making dashboards simple to read and practical to update, so they support decision-making rather than adding complexity.

Relevant experience includes my Sales KPI dashboard project for Marlowe Furniture, where I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. That work consolidated 14 reports into 1 and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That project strengthened my experience with data modeling, Excel reporting, and building dashboards that make performance data easier to understand.

For your project, I would bring the same structured approach: clean data entry, dependable analysis, and reporting that makes productivity trends visible at a glance. I’m comfortable working independently, paying close attention to detail, and meeting deadlines consistently.

If you’d like, I can also share how I would set up the tracker fields and dashboard layout before we begin. I’d be glad to discuss your current process and help you build a practical productivity tracking system.
